ROLE: Register the nonblocking listener descriptor in the epoll set for EPOLLIN only, tagged with a NULL event data pointer so loop_run() can tell listener events from session events.

STRUCT.NAME: struct loop
STRUCT.ROLE: reactor receiving the registration; stores the borrowed descriptor number and uses it for accepting

STRUCT.NAME: struct epoll_event
STRUCT.ROLE: registration record: events mask plus the NULL data pointer tag used for the listener

VAR.NAME: EPOLL_CTL_ADD
VAR.ROLE: epoll operation code for the first registration

VAR.NAME: EPOLLIN
VAR.ROLE: only interest requested for the listener: readable pending connections

VAR.NAME: EPOLL_CLOEXEC
VAR.ROLE: not used here; the listener already carries O_NONBLOCK|FD_CLOEXEC from net_listen and its mode is not changed

CALL_CONTRACTS.NAME: epoll_ctl
CALL_CONTRACTS.SIGNATURE: int epoll_ctl(int epfd, int op, int fd, struct epoll_event *event)
CALL_CONTRACTS.RETURN: 0 when the operation succeeded; -1 with errno set to EEXIST for a descriptor already in the set, EBADF for an invalid descriptor number, ENOMEM, or EPERM for a file type that cannot be polled
CALL_CONTRACTS.OWNERSHIP: no descriptor ownership moves; the listener remains owned by main(), which closes it after loop_destroy()
CALL_CONTRACTS.FAILURE: -1 means the listener is not in the epoll set; the function returns -1 and leaves l->listener_fd unchanged so a previous successful registration is never masked by a failed one

LOGIC.INPUT: l: reactor created by loop_create(). listener_fd: the already-nonblocking, already-FD_CLOEXEC listening socket returned by net_listen(); borrowed and never closed here.
LOGIC.ACTION: 1. If l == NULL or listener_fd < 0 return -1. 2. Build struct epoll_event ev; zero it first so no uninitialised bytes reach the kernel: ev.events = EPOLLIN (level-triggered; EPOLLET is never set) and ev.data.ptr = NULL (the listener tag; session events carry a struct session pointer instead). 3. rc = epoll_ctl(l->epfd, EPOLL_CTL_ADD, listener_fd, &ev). 4. If rc != 0 return -1 without touching l->listener_fd. 5. On success l->listener_fd = listener_fd and return 0.
LOGIC.OUTPUT: 0 with the listener registered for EPOLLIN: loop_run() will receive events whose data.ptr is NULL and will call accept_ready(). -1 when l is NULL, listener_fd is negative, or epoll_ctl failed (descriptor already registered, bad descriptor, allocation failure); on -1 no registration was added and l->listener_fd keeps its previous value (-1 before the first successful call).
INVARIANTS_USED: the listener is a nonblocking descriptor, so dispatching a read-side accept loop can never block the reactor
listener events are identified by data.ptr == NULL; session events always carry a non-NULL session pointer
the loop never closes or modifies the listener: mode changes are made by net_listen() before this call
LOGIC.PRECONDITION: l is a live reactor with an open epoll descriptor; listener_fd is a listening socket already in nonblocking mode.
LOGIC.POSTCONDITION: either the listener is unambiguously registered for EPOLLIN with the NULL tag, or the epoll set is exactly as it was before the call.
LOGIC.THREAD_SAFETY: Called once before loop_run(); no concurrent access.

INPUT.listener_fd: same descriptor as a successful first call
